apps.name: iSharpe Depot
apps.description: Installs and updates all of iSharpe's phone apps, including itself.
apps.releaseNotes: My Apps is now called iSharpe Depot. Nothing else changes: same app, same updates.

apps.name: Sharp
apps.description: A clean home screen: the apps you pick, then one A–Z list of everything with a letter strip to jump through it.
apps.releaseNotes: New: Settings > Backup. Save your home screen, folders, bottom bar and layout to a file, and restore it later or on another phone or tablet. Widgets have to be added again.

apps.name: Weather Line
apps.description: Weather in one line: a home-screen widget with today's high, low and chance of rain, shaded for sunrise and sunset.
apps.releaseNotes: Under the bar, in one line: the sky (Cloudy, Rain...), sunrise, the chance of rain (always shown, even 0%) with the day's total, and sunset. The bar keeps the temperatures.
